It differs from the 2017-2018 executive actions because those efforts largely bogged down in multi-year agency friction and incremental agency guidance, whereas the current climate features a hardened, highly centralized apparatus explicitly pre-prepared with fully drafted, high-magnitude regulatory texts designed for immediate publication without the exploratory lag that characterized the first term.
